topics.title: Pig Momming and Kennedy Scandals
topics.summary: The broadcast features a bizarre segment about ‘pig momming’ at Dance Potatoes followed by discussions of the Kennedy family scandal involving alleged rape. Later, guests discuss lottery winnings and debate The Who’s music while exploring interviewing rock stars; one host makes outlandish claims regarding sulfuric acid injuries.

topics.title: Townsend’s Womanhood Claim and Band Dynamics
topics.summary: During an interview, members of Bad Company discuss Townsend’s assertion that he is a woman, leading to confused debate about his past behavior and financial difficulties within the band. They make lighthearted observations regarding their lifestyles and musical influences while referencing unresolved tensions with former member Kenny Jones.

topics.title: Mud Baths and Car Deals
topics.summary: During a casual conversation, participants discuss Ronnie Wood’s mud bath experience alongside anecdotes about rock stars like Rod Stewart and the complexities of buying cars in England. They also explore musical influences including "Bad Company" hits and a discussion regarding a horse box, while briefly mentioning an advertisement for Snapple.

topics.title: Andy Fotos Radio Show & Audience Reactions
topics.summary: During a radio segment, host Andy Fotos attempts to introduce new music by a local band while taking calls and gauging audience reactions through detailed clap-time measurements (recorded in seconds). The conversation includes promotional talk about his Hackensack Ford Mazda dealership and various humorous comments from the listeners.

topics.title: Rock Star Phone Calls and Confusion
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts repeatedly attempt to contact Sam Kinison but are met with no response, leading to frustration and speculation about his whereabouts. They discuss eccentric rock stars’ early performance habits while also engaging in tangential conversations regarding lottery winnings and mathematical calculations.

topics.title: Mathematical Mishaps and Strange News
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts discuss an incorrect calculation involving $31 people receiving $370,000 each. They then cover unrelated topics including a woman trampled by elephants at a zoo, a giraffe being roasted in South Africa, Matt Dillon’s erratic behavior during an interview and a lawsuit against a hairdresser for excessive hair cutting.
